headline: A quiet day — no content packs changed, and the first content export since 8 September
summary_md:

- Upstream head was `8b3bcee` of 29 September 19:22 +03:00, so nothing landed in `demisto/content` during the day itself.
- This is the first content snapshot on the mirror since 2026-09-08. No snapshot covers 9–29 September, so a pack that moved in those three weeks is not recorded here.
- No pack was added, updated or withdrawn, so there is nothing here to act on.
